title: Bassettbaby Drop-Side Cribs Recalled Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazard
summary: Spindles on the drop-side of the crib could loosen, creating a gap that poses an entrapment and strangulation hazard. Units: 18.

title: Mission City Press Recalls Girl's Bracelet Sets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the pearl white beads of the bracelet, contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 11,000.

title: Polaris Industries Expands Recall of ATVs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The ATVs can have defective Electronic Control Modules (ECM) that overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to riders. Units: About 95,000 (This recall was first announced in May 2005).

title: Boys' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Siegfried & Parzifal Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 5,000.

title: Christmas Tree Shops Recalls Tea Light Candles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The tea light candles have a clear, plastic shell that can melt or ignite, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 146,000.

title: Remote-Controlled Helicopter Toys Recalled By Soft Air USA Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable battery contained inside the helicopter can catch fire during charging, igniting the helicopter and nearby combustible materials. This poses a burn or fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: General Electric Recalls Gas Dryers Due to Shock Hazard
summary: A short circuit in the dryer's wiring poses a shock hazard to consumers with ungrounded dryers. Units: About 2,100.

title: Netshops Recalls Children's Table and Chair Sets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the children's table and chair sets contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 50.

title: Pendants and Candle Charms Recalled Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled pendants and charms contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 460,000.

title: Trek Recalls Girls' Bicycles Due To Frame Failure
summary: The bicycle's frame can break during use, causing the rider to lose control and suffer injuries. Units: About 49,000.

title: West Music Recalls Egg-Shaker Toy Instruments Due to Choking and Aspiration Hazards
summary: The end cap can detach from the egg shaker and allow the small beads to spill out, posing choking/aspiration hazards to young children. Units: About 5,500.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Seventy Two Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Nordstrom Stores
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,800.

title: Children's Sketchbooks Recalled by eeBoo Corp. Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the sketchbooks' colored spiral metal bindings contains excessive levels of lead violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 80,000.

title: Children's Toy Gardening Rakes Recalled by Downeast Concepts; Violates Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the gardening tool hand rake contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal standard on lead in paint on toys. Units: About 400.

title: Munire Furniture Recalls Cribs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cribs fail to meet the federal safety standards for cribs. The four support brackets on the mattress support spring are too long. title: Children's Memory Testing Cards Recalled by Riverside Publishing Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the cards contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 5,300.

title: Children's Metal Jewelry Recalled by Pecoware Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The children's necklaces contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,900.

title: Family Dollar Recalls Magnetic Dart Boards; Ingested Magnets Pose Aspiration and Intestinal Hazards
summary: Small magnets at the ends of the darts can detach. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforations or blockages, which can be fatal. Units: About 250,000.

title: Greenheck Fan Recalls Indirect Gas Fired Furnaces Due to Risk of Fire
summary: The ignition control module can fail preventing the unit from shutting down in high temperature conditions. This poses a risk of fire, as well as hazardous fumes being released from burning/melting insulation. Units: About 1,500.

title: Rinnai Recalls Wall Furnaces Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: A gasket in the unit can fail, posing a risk of poisonous carbon monoxide gas leaking into the home. Units: About 52,000.

title: Louisville Ladder Recalls Extension Ladders Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The extension or "fly" section can fail to lock, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,000.

title: Portable Electric Heaters Recalled by Aloha Housewares Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The portable electric heater can overheat and melt plastic parts, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 152,000.

title: Cinderella Battery-Powered Toy Cars Recalled by Dumar International USA Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The wires under the hood of the car and/or in the battery compartment under the seat can short circuit, posing a fire and burn hazard to children riding in the car. Units: About 64,000.

title: Spiderman Water Bottles Sold Exclusively at Sears Recalled by Fast Forward Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Screws under the bottle's lid can come loose and fall into the cup, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 6,600.
